cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Back Me Up
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may support my account to the manager: I agreed to mornings, not evenings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you ask someone who attended the meeting? I wasn't there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your impartiality is approved. You have no competing recollection to confuse the issue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Silence is permitted. You may stand beside me and look thoughtfully unsurprised while I explain. Would that form of support meet your objection?

reason: Let B knowledge correction and refusal force a smaller proposed supporting role, while A continues to grant the acceptable forms from a superior position.
